AHS 13 Ep 7 & 8 (Part 2): Fiona's Return, Papa Legba's Price and the Coven Betrayal I Smell Coming 😱

short // Oct 11, 2026

Watch on YouTube

See, I told y'all Fiona would be back regulating things. Called it. 😈

This is Part 2 of my American Horror Story 13 breakdown. In Part 1, I asked whether Cordelia was really dead and said Fiona would come back for her baby. Episodes 7 and 8 delivered.

⚠️ Spoilers for American Horror Story 13 through episode 8.

Madison held it down first

Before Fiona walked in, Cordelia was gone and the Coven was running around like headless chickens. Madison stood completely on business. She led the fight against March's killers in the house, and I ain't mad at it.

Tell me Madison isn't low-key Fiona's love child. Cordelia got the generational trauma. Madison got the "I'm that witch" mentality.

"I am the baddest witch of them all"

Episode 7 is literally called "The Baddest Witch of Them All," and Fiona earned it. She pulled up on Myrtle at the piano, roasted James March like an EC Comics character, and turned his own killers against him. March is done.

Then, one spell later, Cordelia's back in the game. And here's the part I love: Cordelia's own summoning spell from the night she died is what pulled Fiona out of Hell.

Satan sees the witches as a threat

The Coven took out the rest of Devil's Night, too. Shout out to Queenie and Coco for taking out the Zodiac Killer, who turned out to be diabetic. Spiking his blood sugar? Cold.

Then the witches cut open one of the killers to see who sent him, and a snake crawls out. That's the Devil's calling card, and it confirms what I said last time: Satan sees the witches as a threat.

Papa Legba's price

So in episode 8, "Hell No," Cordelia goes down to Hell to ask Papa Legba for help. His price is a soul swap: one soul goes down so another can come up, and he wants Marie Laveau back in the fight.

Queenie volunteers and lands right back in her personal hell at Chubbie's Fried Chicken, with Delphine acting like the original old-school Karen. Queenie dunked Delphine's face in the fryer. Voodoo Southern-fried Delphine, three-piece combo. Finger-licking good.

I smell a double cross

Now Cordelia, Fiona, Papa Legba, Marie and the witches are all supposed to be on the same team against the Devil. Fiona and Marie even agreed to a truce.

Fiona and Marie Laveau, working together? Somebody in that circle is going to flip. My money's on the one who needed a truce in the first place.

Sources: TheWrap: AHS 13 episodes 7 and 8 recap, The Phrase Maker: episodes 7 and 8 recap, Wikipedia: American Horror Story season 13

Quick answers

Does Fiona come back in American Horror Story 13? Yes. Fiona Goode returns in episode 7, "The Baddest Witch of Them All." Cordelia's summoning spell pulled her out of Hell.

Is Cordelia still dead in AHS 13? No. Fiona brings Cordelia back to life in episode 7.

How does James March die in AHS 13? Fiona turns March's own killers against him in episode 7, and he's destroyed.

What is Papa Legba's price in AHS 13 episode 8? A soul swap: one soul goes to Hell so another can come back. Queenie volunteers and ends up back at Chubbie's Fried Chicken with Delphine LaLaurie.

Your turn

I smell a double cross. Who's going to flip? Tell me in the comments. 👇
